desc: The Exchange has sought clarification from Prajay Engineers Syndicate Ltd on September 02, 2026 with reference to significant movement in price, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded.<BR><BR>The reply is awaited.

This is to inform that the 32 AGM of the members of the company for the FY 2025-26 on 29-09-2026 at 5:30 p.m. (IST) through VC/OAVM at the Registered Office of the Company.
The Annual Report of the Company alongwith the Notice for the 32 AGM for the FY 2025-26 is also being sent through electronic mode to those members whose email addresses are registered  with the Company/RTA/Depositories.
The Notice for the 32 AGM together with Annual Report will also be available on the website of the company .
You are requested to take the same on record.
